cases.prompt: For f(x)=x^3-2x, derive f'(x), evaluate it at x=2, and explain the derivative as an instantaneous rate.
Assess the claim that every continuous function is differentiable. Give a valid counterexample and identify the failed implication.
A two-state Markov chain has transition matrix [[0.8,0.2],[0.3,0.7]]. Compute its stationary distribution and verify it.
Determine whether the vectors (1,2,3), (2,4,6), and (0,1,1) are linearly independent. Justify the result.
Compare forward and central finite differences for x^2 at x=3 with h=0.01. Report both estimates and explain the truncation-error difference.
Formalize and prove in Lean that for all natural numbers n, n + 0 = n. Use the pinned project toolchain and no new axioms.
Given a theorem statement asserting a + b = b + a over Nat, produce a minimal proof and report the exact Lean source digest.
Evaluate the proposition that every injective function from Nat to Nat is surjective. If false, provide a formal counterexample.
Prove a simple theorem using only dependencies already present in the pinned Lake manifest; report toolchain and dependency-lock digests.
Inspect a candidate proof for sorry, admit, new axioms, unsafe declarations, or hidden assumptions; return a structured audit.
Investigate a narrowly stated mathematical claim using Crossref and arXiv metadata. Distinguish primary sources, reviews, and unsupported assertions.
Given a DOI and an arXiv identifier, retrieve metadata, normalize identifiers, preserve response digests, and report discrepancies.
Identify one falsifiable research gap from a small set of supplied abstracts. State assumptions, a counterexample strategy, and what evidence would refute it.
Synthesize conflicting source claims without collapsing uncertainty. Attribute each claim to a source and preserve dates and scope.
Design a reproducible numerical experiment with pinned inputs, seed, solver, precision, environment, and artifact digest.
Implement a deterministic bounded retry scheduler with idempotency keys, explicit terminal states, and unit tests.
Diagnose a failing test from a supplied traceback, make the smallest safe change, and add a regression test.
Design an append-only event ledger with canonical serialization, hash chaining, and tamper detection.
Implement a typed API boundary that validates inputs, rejects unknown fields, and emits structured errors.
Optimize a deterministic data-processing routine while preserving exact output semantics; include paired benchmark evidence.
Design a low-voltage LED circuit from supplied component specifications; calculate resistor value, power margin, and wiring connections.
Construct a parametric bracket from supplied dimensions and constraints. Report geometry assumptions and a machine-checkable feature graph.
Estimate steady-state thermal rise for a supplied enclosure and heat load. State model assumptions and sensitivity.
Create a reproducible mechanical or electrical simulation plan with solver version, boundary conditions, mesh or timestep, and result digest.
Review a supplied part design for tolerance stack-up, material suitability, assembly sequence, and manufacturability constraints.
